_RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_TRANSCRIPT.method: verbatim desde transcripción de sesión (lectura completa previa a la pérdida); único cambio: este campo _RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_TRANSCRIPT añadido como banner de procedencia

movement_type_enum: sale, purchase, adjustment, return, initial, transfer, void, transfer_in, transfer_out, sale_void, production_out, production_in, sale_reverse, purchase_reverse, production_reverse, issue_slip_out, issue_slip_reverse
payment_constraints:
payment_transactions_amount_check|CHECK ((amount > (0)::numeric))
payment_transactions_payment_method_check|CHECK ((payment_method = ANY (ARRAY['cash'::text, 'transfer'::text, 'zelle'::text])))
payment_transactions_sale_ref_check|CHECK (((ref_type <> 'sale'::text) OR ((transaction_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ref_id = transaction_id))))
payment_transactions_ref_type_check|CHECK ((ref_type = ANY (ARRAY['receipt'::text, 'service'::text, 'production_order'::text, 'work'::text, 'sale'::text, 'commission'::text])))
payment_transactions_currency_check|CHECK ((currency = ANY (ARRAY['CUP'::text, 'USD'::text, 'EUR'::text, 'MLC'::text])))
payment_transactions_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
payment_transactions_transaction_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
devolution_constraints:
devolution_items_total_check|CHECK ((total >= (0)::numeric))
devolution_items_unit_price_check|CHECK ((unit_price >= (0)::numeric))
devolution_items_quantity_check|CHECK ((quantity > (0)::numeric))
devolution_items_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
devolutions_payment_method_check|CHECK ((payment_method = ANY (ARRAY['cash'::text, 'transfer'::text, 'zelle'::text, 'store_credit'::text])))
devolutions_total_amount_check|CHECK ((total_amount >= (0)::numeric))
devolutions_status_check|CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'completed'::text, 'voided'::text, 'reversed'::text])))
devolutions_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
devolution_items_devolution_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (devolution_id) REFERENCES devolutions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
devolution_items_product_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
devolutions_original_transaction_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (original_transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
devolutions_customer_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
devolutions_store_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
devolutions_voided_by_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (voided_by) REFERENCES profiles(id)
devolutions_reversed_by_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (reversed_by) REFERENCES profiles(id)
devolutions_processed_by_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (processed_by) REFERENCES profiles(id)
